title: iKratom is now a place to organize together
subject: New on iKratom: local groups, friends, and your own profile
preheader: Start or join a group for your town, chat live, plan call-in days, add friends, and choose exactly who sees what.
intro: Advocacy works best with people you know. iKratom now has everything you need to organize locally and keep each other going, free and @username only.

blocks.heading: Groups for your town, county or state
blocks.body: One invite link and QR code that never runs out, live group chat, a discussion board, events and call-in days with reminders, and one shared action each week with a progress bar that counts actions, never names.

blocks.heading: Pinned resources and testimony templates
blocks.body: Organizers can pin the links and ready-made letters their group needs. A template opens straight in the email composer, addressed to your officials.

blocks.heading: Your profile, your friends
blocks.body: Add a photo, a cover and an album, post on your wall, and connect with friends. Photos have their location data removed when you upload them.

blocks.heading: You choose who sees what
blocks.body: Every part of your profile can be Only me, Friends, Members or Public, with a live preview of what others see. Everyone appears as @username, and anything can be reported.

blocks.heading: Bring one person
blocks.body: Every group starts with two. Forward this email or share ikratom.org/connect with someone who cares about kratom.
